summary: A floor-standing billiard cue rack: a walnut base with eight butt cups, turned uprights, a top rail with eigh… joints cue_0, cue_1, cue_2, cue_3, cue_4, cue_5, …; options wood; sockets cue_slot_0, cue_slot_1, cue_slot_2, cue_slot_3, cue_slot_4, cue_slot_5, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.billiard_cue_rack or place "prefab": "billiard_cue_rack" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
